entity.user.field.uuid: The unique identifier of the user (UUID).

entity.user.field.nickname: The display name or nickname of the user.
entity.user.field.avatar: The URL of the user's avatar image.

entity.user.field.status: The status of the user account (e.g., active, inactive).

entity.user.field.sanction_date: The date until which the user is sanctioned.
